claims.statement: The observed read-only transition occurs after an MTD/UBI I/O error chain.
The current strongest hypothesis is incorrect ECC status mapping rather than confirmed media failure.

recommendations: Run discriminating correctable/uncorrectable ECC cases before changing UBIFS behavior
risks: A bad fix could suppress true uncorrectable media errors
unverified_items: Whether BDMA and RIU paths interpret the same ECC status identically
